# SINOQI
# Hangzhou Sinoqi Industry and Trade Co.,LTD
# Decorative materials manufacturer since 1990
# https://www.sqdecor.com

## About
SINOQI is an integrated manufacturing and trading company based in Hangzhou, China, specializing in decorative building materials for B2B distributors, importers, wholesalers, and project buyers. Founded in 1990, the company operates a 29,220 m² factory with 110 employees and a capacity of 300 × 40HQ containers per month across four product lines.

- PVC Ceiling Panels: https://www.sqdecor.com/pvc-ceiling-panel/

## B2B Terms
- MOQ: 100 pieces per design and color
- Lead Time: 30 days from deposit
- Samples: Free (buyer pays courier)
- OEM/Customization: Evaluated per request
- Export Markets: Latin America, Southeast Asia, United States, Middle East, India
